question_text: A clinic stores Patient(PatientID, Name) and Condition(PatientID, ConditionCode, Notes). A patient may have many conditions. Explain why separate condition rows are preferable to Condition1, Condition2,… columns, and how a database view can limit what reception staff see.
adaptation_rationale: Keep normalization and view-based security, not unsupported general legal assertions. Scenario and wording rewritten; source reasoning retained only within supported 2027 scope.
